title: Tightening Bounds on Probabilities of Causation By Merging Datasets
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical derivation of symbolic bounds for Probabilities of Causation (PoC), a causal inference framework. While PoC has applications in ethically sensitive domains like law, healthcare, and public policy (e.g., safety assessments), the paper's core contribution is methodological – providing tools to calculate and tighten these probabilities. It does not evaluate or benchmark ethical theories, moral reasoning, or faith itself.
